voiceGender_p1: This function adjusts the gender of a voice to male, female, or keeps the original tone.It works based on the Transpose principle (pitch shifting), which alters the pitch level in semitone units as follows:
voiceGender_li_2: 2. Male (-9) - Lowers the pitch by nearly one octave, making the voice deeper and more masculine.
voiceGender_li_3: 3. Female (+9) - Raises the pitch by nearly one octave, making the voice brighter and more feminine.
voiceGender_p2: These values are optimal for changing the vocal tone without causing distortion or unnatural sound
voiceLevelTranspose_p_1: This function is used to adjust the pitch of a voice to match the desired tone. The adjustment is measured in semitones (12 semitones = 1 octave).
voiceLevelTranspose_li_1: Increasing the value (+) raises the pitch, making the voice brighter and higher.
voiceLevelTranspose_li_2: Decreasing the value (-) lowers the pitch, making the voice deeper and richer.
voiceLevelTranspose_p_2: This feature is ideal for matching the vocal tone to a specificsong or style without affecting the tempo or playback speed.
similarityLevel_p1: This function defines how closely the generated voice matches the original voice. It offers three levels of similarity adjustment:
similarityLevel_li_1: 1. Quick Generate (Low) - Fast processing speed, suitable for testing or creating rough samples.
similarityLevel_li_2: 2. Normal (Medium) - Provides a balanced result between speed and similarity, ideal for general use.
similarityLevel_li_3: 3. Professional (High) - Delivers detailed processing with the highest resemblance to the original voice, suitable for high-quality or professional production.
